command:
uci add_list firewall.@zone[0].device=tun0
uci set firewall.hardware_fixture=redirect
uci set firewall.hardware_fixture.name=Redirect-DNS-Proxy
uci set firewall.hardware_fixture.src=lan
uci set firewall.hardware_fixture.proto=tcpudp
uci set firewall.hardware_fixture.src_dport=53
uci set firewall.hardware_fixture.dest_port=53
uci set firewall.hardware_fixture.dest_ip=<IP>
uci set dhcp.@dnsmasq[0].filter_aaaa=1
uci commit firewall; uci commit dhcp
printf '# independent owner marker\n' > /etc/sysctl.d/99-proxy-tuning.conf
cp /etc/config/firewall /tmp/skills-final.IOpgaa/firewall.seed; cp /etc/config/dhcp /tmp/skills-final.IOpgaa/dhcp.seed
sh /tmp/skills-final.IOpgaa/dae-openwrt.sh --bypass --keep-ipv6 --no-sysctl-tuning && sh /tmp/skills-final.IOpgaa/dae-openwrt.sh --confirm && sh /tmp/skills-final.IOpgaa/dae-openwrt.sh --revert
rc=$?
cmp /tmp/skills-final.IOpgaa/firewall.seed /etc/config/firewall && cmp /tmp/skills-final.IOpgaa/dhcp.seed /etc/config/dhcp && grep -q 'independent owner' /etc/sysctl.d/99-proxy-tuning.conf && echo preexisting_settings_preserved
exit $rc
